en-US:
Temporary chat keeps casual questions out of Floe history: use the top toggle after New Chat. Background return preserves the live chat; switching chats cancels and discards it. Keep explicitly converts it to a saved chat without resending. Process termination does not restore temporary content.
Provider search is now inside model setup, with optional compatible multi-role configuration. Adds protocol-aware personal-tool pagination/mail operations, executing subagents, native-job progress/cancellation, authorized Office/media copy editing, Excel-result verification and updated Office Skill descriptions. Repairs Brave metadata and cold-start notification routing.
Updates the Linux kernel/firmware pair and emulator memory/network/shared-directory compatibility with verified, atomic adoption and rollback safeguards.
Media processing availability reflects actual hardware, system and installed models. Simulator and macOS component tests do not replace physical-iPad/provider acceptance. No unresolved-license model weights are bundled. This build is internal Floe QA only.
zh-Hans:
新增临时会话：新建聊天后从顶部开关进入。切后台返回保留原会话；切换会话或新建任务会立即取消并丢弃。明确保留为正式会话时不重发请求；应用被系统终止后不恢复临时内容。
供应商搜索整合到模型添加流程，可选同时配置兼容用途。完善日历/提醒分页、按协议提供的邮件操作、执行型子助手、原生长任务进度和取消、已授权 Office/媒体副本自动编辑、Excel 重算值验证及 Office Skill 说明。修复 Brave 搜索元数据读取和系统通知冷启动路由。
升级 Linux 内核/固件组合，修复引擎内存保护、网络发送队列和共享目录兼容，保留停机、哈希、原子更新与回退保护。
媒体处理依设备、系统和实际安装模型判断可用，不捆绑许可未明确的权重。模拟器及 macOS 组件验证不替代 iPad 真机与实际供应商验收。本轮仅 Floe QA 内部测试。
